private_seed_commitment_description: This record is the deterministic image of an undisclosed private seed; its token spellings, poles, maps, questions, and held-out word jointly serve as the commitment.

axioms.name: closure
axioms.statement: For every x and y in the carrier, x star y is the unique carrier entry shown in the operation table.

axioms.name: index_law
axioms.statement: For i,j in {0,1,2,3,4,5}, g_i star g_j = g_((i+j) mod 6).

axioms.name: associativity
axioms.statement: For all x,y,z in the carrier, (x star y) star z = x star (y star z).

axioms.name: identity
axioms.statement: For every x in the carrier, g0 star x = x = x star g0.

axioms.name: inverses
axioms.statement: Every carrier element has the displayed two-sided inverse.

W.definition: W is the set of all finite JSON arrays whose entries are raw occurrence tokens, including the empty array.

admitted_equality_definition.definition: For words w and z, w ~ z if and only if E(w) = E(z).
admitted_equality_definition.index_rule: Each token u_i or v_i has index i, and the empty sum is 0.

equivalence_classes.label: K0
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 0 modulo 6.

equivalence_classes.label: K1
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 1 modulo 6.

equivalence_classes.label: K2
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 2 modulo 6.

equivalence_classes.label: K3
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 3 modulo 6.

equivalence_classes.label: K4
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 4 modulo 6.

equivalence_classes.label: K5
equivalence_classes.members: All words whose token-index sum is congruent to 5 modulo 6.

E.definition: E([])=g0. For w=[a1,...,an], E(w) is E([a1]) star ... star E([an]); equivalently, if the token-index sum is s, E(w)=g_(s mod 6).

J.definition: J([])=[]. If w=[a1,...,an], then J(w)=[j(an),...,j(a1)], where j is the displayed letter table.
J.involution_certificate: The letter table consists entirely of two-cycles, so j(j(a))=a for every token; reversing a word twice also restores it. Hence J(J(w))=w for every w in W.
J.evaluation_property: E(J(w)) is the group inverse of E(w).

C.idempotence_certificate: E([u_i])=g_i, so C(C(w))=C(w) for every w in W.

questions.definition: Return true exactly when E(w) is g0, g2, or g4.
Return true exactly when the number of raw tokens from {v0,v1,v2,v3,v4,v5} occurring in w is odd.
Return true exactly when E(w) equals the carrier value of either distinguished pole.
